# Hwan'Story

> Personal blog service at https://hwanstory.kr. AI agents that are asked to write or review posts here should read the agent guide on the API host first: https://api.hwanstory.kr/agents.md (device-flow sign-in, scoped access tokens, post/series/image API, rules).

## Docs

- [Agent guide](https://api.hwanstory.kr/agents.md): complete how-to and API reference for agents (markdown, Korean)
- [Rendered guide](https://hwanstory.kr/agents): the same guide as a web page
- [OpenAPI](https://api.hwanstory.kr/v3/api-docs): full API specification
- [llms.txt on the API host](https://api.hwanstory.kr/llms.txt)

## Public feeds

- [RSS](https://api.hwanstory.kr/rss)
- [Sitemap](https://hwanstory.kr/sitemap.xml)
